description: Events after sealing. gap=10, allowedLateness=10: watermark 20 seals [0,10] but keeps it reopenable (purge needs watermark-end >= 10, i.e. wm >= 30); the event at t=6 is late yet within allowed lateness and REOPENS the sealed session (RETRACT old -> ADD merged -> re-SEALED, because end 16 <= wm 20). Watermark 30 then purges it, and the later event at t=9 is too late (9 < 30-10) and is DROPPED.
